audience: businesses that run digital loyalty cards in Dokun

useCases.title: List recent card customers who gave consent
useCases.text: List the 200 most recent card customers. Check the marketing consent date of each one.

useCases.title: Review the newest sign-ups
useCases.text: List the newest card customers with their name, sign-up time and marketing consent date. Use the list to see how many joined recently.

useCases.title: Add stamps at the counter
useCases.text: Add one or more stamps to a card by its serial or scanned QR text. Use the receipt number as the key, so a retry adds the stamp once.
